summary: Project with PDF export functionality using jsPDF. Focus on fixing 'bad URL' errors by using built-in fonts only, no external resources, and direct synchronous download via jsPDF's save() method.
architectural_notes: PDF export uses jsPDF with built-in fonts only — no custom font loading or external image/asset requests
PDF download triggered synchronously from button click using jsPDF save() method; no window.open() or new windows to avoid popup blockers

existing_features.title: Rewrite the pioneers PDF export utility (frontend/src/utils/pioneersPdfExport.ts) to use jsPDF with only built-in fonts (e.g., 'helvetica'), no custom font loading, no external image or asset loading, and no window.open() calls. Generate the PDF entirely from in-memory data and trigger the download synchronously using jsPDF's built-in save() method. The output should be a clean, functional PDF with black text on a white background and a basic bordered table layout showing monthly hours, totals, averages, and status per pioneer.

Rewrite the tasks PDF export utility (frontend/src/utils/tasksPdfExport.ts) to use jsPDF with only built-in fonts, no external resource loading, and no window.open() calls. Trigger the download synchronously using jsPDF's save() method. Output a clean PDF with black text on white background and a basic bordered table layout showing task title, due date, category, status, and notes.

Rewrite the notes PDF export utility (frontend/src/utils/notesPdfExport.ts) to use jsPDF with only built-in fonts, no external resource loading, and no window.open() calls. Trigger the download synchronously using jsPDF's save() method. Output a clean PDF with black text on white background, grouping notes by category with basic section headers and a simple layout.

projectName: Fix PDF export to use built-in fonts, no external resources, and direct synchronous download
